task: Find the best candidates on Hugging Face: text-generation models under 2B parameters with a permissive license that are not gated.
done_when: A list of top 3 candidates with their Hugging Face URLs and license information.

task: Open the Hugging Face page for each of the top 3 candidates and check the license and the real size of its weights files. Item: {item}
done_when: The license and real size of weights files for each of the top 3 candidates are verified.

task: Write and run a benchmark on this machine that loads each of the 3 models on CPU and measures load time, memory used and tokens per second, and checks how many of 10 simple arithmetic questions each one answers correctly.
done_when: The benchmark results for each of the 3 models are collected and verified.

task: Write a ranked recommendation with sources based on the benchmark results and verified information.
done_when: A ranked recommendation with sources is written and verified.
